entries.text: MAHALO FOR YOUR PARTICIPATION! Thank you, everyone, for taking part in Food4Thought this month. With Knowledge Builders, games, workshops, service & letter-writing, advocacy, guest speakers, and the Thanksgiving Food Drive, you learned and did a lot! We truly appreciated this ONE TEAM effort for food security! Happy Thanksgiving!!

entries.title: NAMI Club Event
entries.text: Take a breather and join NAMI today, Wed, 11/25, during mtg pd and lunch at the Arillaga Takaki Terrace Floor Commons for a relaxing afternoon of cookie decorating! We’re featuring the viral TikTok dot cookie trend alongside a variety of other classic sugar cookie flavors and frostings. Bring a friend and unwind with us!

GIVE THANKS AND BRING YOUR APPETITE! Get ready to celebrate Thanksgiving with some friendly competition, festive fun, and plenty of holiday spirit! Join us on the Pā today, Wed, 11/25, for our Thanksgiving Celebration, featuring a crowd favorite: the Pumpkin Pie Eating Contest!

entries.title: The Pumpkin Pie Eating Contest
entries.text: Today, Wed, 11/25. Think you have what it takes to claim the title? Watch 8 contestants go head-to-head in a battle for pumpkin pie supremacy! We will have 2 faculty/staff, and 6 students, with one from each grade. Please complete the attached form. If more than one student from each grade signs up, we will default to a first-come first-serve basis, choosing the first student that signs up from that grade.Bring your friends and something to be thankful for. Cheer on your classmates and teachers, and join us in celebrating the holiday of gratitude.
VIRTUAL POP-UP! Get your Young Entrepreneurs Club Virtual Pop-up pre-orders in before it's too late! Pickup will be Monday, November 30.

GOT AN IDEA WORTH SHARING? Step onto the ‘Iolani TEDEd stage. Come to the TEDEd Speaker Interest Meeting on Tuesday, December 1st during lunch in ASC-301 to learn how YOU can speak at this year’s ‘Iolani TEDed Event in April! Open to all 9th-12th grade students interested in presenting a short talk to an audience on their unique passions, insights, interests, curiosities, and perspectives. If you are interested but unable to attend the kick-off meeting, email Mr. Andrews (jandrews@iolani.org).

entries.title: Student Deliberbation Lab
entries.text: Calling ALL students who want to weigh in on our school's AI policies! As digital tools and AI evolve, how effectively do our current handbook policies balance clear behavioral and academic standards with fair enforcement and student safety and growth? Join the Student Deliberation Lab in a student-led deliberation to discuss on December 1, lunch, in W310. Summaries will be shared with administration to elevate student voices on this issue. We hope to see you there!

entries.title: Thanksgiving Chapel
entries.text: All 7th and 8th Grade Homerooms - Please leave your personal belongings in homeroom for Thanksgiving Chapel. You can retrieve them after chapel. Also, please enter the Lower Gym on the Autoline side of the gym. Thank you.

entries.title: Biology Club
entries.text: How does the genetic code of life clone itself? Come model DNA replication using candy at the BioClub mtg today, Wed, 11/25 during mtg pd. Snacks are provided; bring friends.

entries.title: Filipino Club
entries.text: MOVIE & JOLLIBEE! Thanksgiving is almost here, and we're celebrating Filipino Club style! Join us for a fun afternoon of Jollibee and a movie! We'll be watching Forgotten Island while enjoying some delicious Jollibee! Today, Wed, Nov 25, during lunch & meeting period, N-208. IMPORTANT: This event is for PAID Filipino Club members ONLY! Come hungry, bring your friends from the club, and enjoy some Filipino food, fun, and fellowship before Thanksgiving break! Questions? Feel free to reach out! Hope to see you there!

entries.text: Join the next meeting on Tuesday, December 1 at lunch in ASC303! There will be snacks and a special Thanksgiving project.

entries.title: Pacific Pride Club
entries.text: Calling all Pacific Stride Club members! We have TWO fun running events coming up this Thanksgiving week! Check your email from the club officers for details and sign-up information! Today, WED, 11/25 – TURKEY TROT RELAY & ALA MOANA RUN, Location: ‘Iolani Track Time: 3:20 PM (arrive with your entire team!) Get your team of FOUR together for a fun Turkey Trot Relay! Each runner completes 400 meters (one lap). Thanksgiving-themed running attire is optional but HIGHLY encouraged! Get festive! The team showing the MOST improvement in its relay time at our next event will win a small prize! BONUS RUN! After the Turkey Trot, we'll run to Ala Moana! Bring money if you'd like to purchase food. THURS, 11/26 – IHS HOMEWARD BOUND 5K. Start your Thanksgiving morning with a meaningful run supporting the Institute for Human Services (IHS)! Location: Mānoa Valley District Park, 2721 Kaʻaipu Avenue. Time: 7:00 AM. Registration is required! Please refer to the email from your club officers for registration details. Questions? Contact aja2901@iolani.org or Auntie Lei at lei@iolani.org. Lace up your running shoes, grab your friends, and let's make this a fun Thanksgiving week of running!

entries.title: Philosophy Club
entries.text: Calling all philosophers! Our long-awaited November meeting will take place today, Wed, 11/25 during mtg pd, ASC-207, and we are joined by Mr. Buchanan as our guest speaker! In this meeting, we will be covering a question as old as time: "Can harming innocent persons be justified by beneficial results to others?" If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to Tata Li (tl2701@iolani.org) or Arina Shumilova (avs2701@iolani.org). We hope to see you there!
